object.structureGuidelines: Clear, logical flow from problem/concept to solution/tools. Utilize H2s and H3s for readability. Include dedicated sections for 'What it is,' 'Why it's important,' 'How it works,' 'Key features to look for,' and 'Top software options.' Consider incorporating real-world examples or case studies. An FAQ section could also be beneficial.
